share-kit.anim-preview.animation-preview.note: Accessible name of the small box that shows an imported animation before it is saved.

share-kit.anim-preview.play.note: Button that plays or pauses the animated preview of an imported animation. Shown pressed while it plays.

share-kit.card.a-module-of-an-unknown-ty.text: A module of an unknown type was left out.
share-kit.card.a-module-of-an-unknown-ty.note: Import note for a module in a shared card whose type Magic Card does not know.

share-kit.card.a-style-line-was-left-out.text: A style line was left out because its name is not allowed.
share-kit.card.a-style-line-was-left-out.note: Import note for a line in the free-form style (CSS) of a shared card whose property name is not valid.

share-kit.card.an-action-was-left-out-be.text: An action was left out because its web address is not a web link or a path on this dashboard ({rule}).
share-kit.card.an-action-was-left-out-be.note: Import note for a tap, hold or double-tap action in a shared card whose link is not a normal web link, for example one that starts with javascript:. {rule} is the id of the check.

vars.rule: The id of the check, for example strict.action-url.

share-kit.card.key-is-not-a-card-setting.text: {key} is not a card setting, so it was left out.
share-kit.card.key-is-not-a-card-setting.note: Import note for a key in a shared card that Magic Card does not know. {key} is the key name.

vars.key: The name of the key that was left out.

share-kit.card.name-points-to-another-we.text: {name} points to another website, so it was left out ({rule}).
share-kit.card.name-points-to-another-we.note: Import note for a card value that loads from another website. {name} is the setting, {rule} the id of the check. The website names are listed beside it.

vars.name: The name of the setting that was left out.
vars.rule: The id of the check, for example strict.host.

share-kit.card.name-uses-a-file-on-the-s.text: "{name}" uses a file on the sharer's Home Assistant. It may not exist on your system.
share-kit.card.name-uses-a-file-on-the-s.note: Import warning for a card value that points to a /local/ file. {name} is the setting in quotes; do not translate it. The sharer is the person who made the file.

vars.name: The name of the setting that uses the file.

share-kit.card.name-was-left-out-because.text: {name} was left out because its value is not allowed ({rule}).
share-kit.card.name-was-left-out-because.note: Import note for a card value that fits no allowed type. {name} is the setting, {rule} the id of the check. The value itself is never shown.

vars.name: The name of the setting that was left out.
vars.rule: The id of the check, for example strict.colour.

share-kit.card.this-is-not-a-magic-card-.text: This is not a Magic Card card.
share-kit.card.this-is-not-a-magic-card-.note: Import error when a shared file holds something other than a Magic Card card. It tells the user nothing was imported.

share-kit.mapping.cancel.note: Button that closes the mapping step without saving.

share-kit.mapping.map-entities.note: Heading of the optional step in an import where placeholders are linked to the importer's own Home Assistant entities.

share-kit.mapping.nothing-here-needs-map.note: Shown in the mapping step when the saved item holds no placeholders any more.

share-kit.mapping.save-mapping.note: Button that saves the entities chosen in the mapping step into the saved image or card.

share-kit.mapping.skip-mapping.note: Button in the import mapping step that clears all chosen entities so the placeholders stay as they are.

share-kit.mapping.that-is-not-an-entity-.text: That is not an entity ID. Use the form {example}.
share-kit.mapping.that-is-not-an-entity-.note: Error under an entity field in the import mapping step. {example} is an example entity ID such as light.name; do not translate it.

vars.example: An example entity ID, for example light.name.

share-kit.mapping.the-preview-shows-valu.note: Shown beside a placeholder: the made-up value the preview uses for it. {value} is a short state such as "on, 80 %" or "21.5 °C".

share-kit.mapping.this-file-uses-placeho.text: This file uses placeholders instead of the sender's entities. Type the entity you want for each one, or skip and do it later. A field you leave empty stays a placeholder.
share-kit.mapping.this-file-uses-placeho.note: Help text above the entity mapping fields of an import. A placeholder is a stand-in entity name such as light.mc_placeholder_1. The sender is the person who made the file.

share-kit.notice.actions-in-this-card.note: Heading above the list of actions a shared card can run, shown before the user confirms an import.

share-kit.notice.actions-in-this-card-he.text: They run only when someone uses the card. Nothing runs when you import it.
share-kit.notice.actions-in-this-card-he.note: Help line under the actions heading of a shared card import.

share-kit.notice.author-name-is-optional.text: Author name is optional. A name is personal data. If you fill it in, it is written into the file and everyone who gets the file can read it. Use a nickname if you prefer, and do not add an email address or contact details. Leave it empty to share without a name.
share-kit.notice.author-name-is-optional.note: Privacy note on the export panel when the items carry an author name. It says the name is personal data and is written into the file.

share-kit.notice.entity-ids-were-replace.text: Entity IDs were replaced with placeholders. Whoever imports this file picks their own devices.
share-kit.notice.entity-ids-were-replace.note: Line under the export text telling the sender that entity IDs were swapped for placeholders.

share-kit.notice.only-import-files-from-.text: Only import files from people you trust. Magic Card checks the file and shows a preview, and nothing is saved until you confirm. Look at the preview, the actions and the templates before you confirm.
share-kit.notice.only-import-files-from-.note: Warning above the preview of every import, before the Confirm button. It tells the user to trust the sender and to look at the preview, actions and templates first.

share-kit.notice.templates-in-this-card.note: Heading above the list of Jinja templates a shared card holds, shown before the user confirms an import.

share-kit.notice.templates-in-this-card-.text: These run on your Home Assistant and can read the state of your entities. They are shown as text here and not run.
share-kit.notice.templates-in-this-card-.note: Help line under the templates heading of a shared card import.
